about: Least-cost expedition corridors on MOLA 8 px/deg topography (~7.4 km cells) with TES daytime surface temperature. Planning corridors, not verified routes.

nodes.name: Viking 1
nodes.summary: First US landing site; flat plains of Chryse Planitia.

nodes.name: Viking 2
nodes.summary: Northern plains of Utopia Planitia; seasonal frost.

nodes.name: Mars Pathfinder
nodes.summary: Ancient flood plain at the mouth of Ares Vallis.

nodes.name: Spirit
nodes.summary: Gusev crater; hot-spring silica at Home Plate.

nodes.name: Opportunity
nodes.summary: Meridiani Planum; hematite and water-formed rocks.

nodes.name: Phoenix
nodes.summary: Arctic plains with water ice centimetres below the surface.

nodes.name: Curiosity
nodes.summary: Gale crater; ancient lake and the layers of Mount Sharp.

nodes.name: InSight
nodes.summary: Flat Elysium Planitia; seismic station.

nodes.name: Perseverance
nodes.summary: Jezero crater river delta; sample cache.

nodes.name: Olympus Mons
nodes.summary: Tallest volcano in the Solar System, about 22 km high.

nodes.name: Tharsis Montes
nodes.summary: Arsia Mons, southernmost of the three Tharsis volcanoes.

nodes.name: Valles Marineris
nodes.summary: Melas Chasma, in the middle of the largest canyon system.

nodes.name: Mawrth Vallis
nodes.summary: Layered clay minerals formed in water.

nodes.name: Aram Chaos
nodes.summary: Collapsed terrain with hematite and sulfates.

nodes.name: Holden crater
nodes.summary: Crater with ancient lake and flood deposits.

nodes.name: Argyre Planitia
nodes.summary: Floor of the Argyre impact basin.

nodes.name: Hellas Planitia
nodes.summary: Deepest basin on Mars; highest air pressure at the surface.

nodes.name: Arcadia Planitia
nodes.summary: Mid-latitude plains with shallow buried ice.

nodes.name: Deuteronilus Mensae
nodes.summary: Mesas wrapped in debris-covered glaciers.

nodes.name: Hebrus Valles
nodes.summary: Channels and possible caves on the Elysium plains.

nodes.name: Elysium Mons
nodes.summary: Second large volcanic province of Mars.

nodes.name: Columbus crater
nodes.summary: Crater with layered sulfate and clay deposits.

nodes.name: Syrtis Major
nodes.summary: Volcanic plains of Syrtis Major Planum.

nodes.name: Terra Cimmeria
nodes.summary: Heavily cratered southern highlands.
